blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Former world title challenger Jeo Santisima is ready to put his experience and toughness to the test against Ukrainian Danylo Honcharuk after both fighters made weight for their WBC Asia Gold super featherweight title showdown on Saturday, November 7, at The Grand Ho Tram in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Santisima tipped the scales at 60.8 kilograms, just 0.2 kg lighter than Honcharuk, who weighed in at 61 kg during Friday’s official weigh-in.
